text: Integrates in about 2 minutes and starts monitoring all LLM requests
quote: It takes 2 mins to integrate and with that, it starts monitoring all of your LLM requests

text: Can be run locally as an open-source AI gateway via a single npx command
quote: npx @portkey-ai/gateway

text: Automatically falls back to next provider/model in a prioritized list if primary fails
quote: Specify a prioritized list of providers/models. If the primary LLM fails, Portkey automatically falls back to the next in line.

text: Logs can be filtered by Config ID to see all requests using that config
quote: Filter logs by `Config ID` to see all requests using that config

text: Automatically retries failed LLM requests with exponential backoff
quote: Automatically retry failed LLM requests with exponential backoff.

text: Can use provider-supplied retry-after headers instead of exponential backoff for retries
quote: Enable `use_retry_after_headers` to use the provider’s `retry-after-ms`, `x-ms-retry-after-ms`, or `retry-after` headers instead of exponential backoff.

text: Distributes traffic across multiple LLMs to avoid bottlenecks on one provider
quote: Distribute traffic across multiple LLMs to prevent any single provider from becoming a bottleneck.

text: Caches LLM responses to serve repeated requests up to 20x faster and cheaper
quote: Cache LLM responses to serve requests up to **20x faster** and cheaper.

text: One Portkey API key gives access to multiple providers and models
quote: The core concept remains the same - one Portkey API key gives you access to multiple providers and models.

text: Provides a single pane for centralized governance, discovery, and usage control of all AI providers/models
quote: A single pane to view and manage every AI provider and model in your organization. It provides centralized governance, discovery, and usage controls for all your AI resources.

text: Logs section shows a chronological list of all requests processed through Portkey
quote: The Logs section presents a chronological list of all the requests processed through Portkey.

text: Each log has a unique shareable URL
quote: Each log on Portkey has a unique URL. You can copy the link from the address bar and directly share it with anyone in your org.

text: Budget and rate limits can be configured on API keys to manage spend and usage
quote: Configure budget and rate limits on API keys to effectively manage AI spending and usage across your organization

text: Sends notifications to configured recipients when usage reaches a threshold
quote: When usage reaches this threshold, notifications will be sent to configured recipients

text: Existing OpenAI SDK setups can integrate Portkey by just changing the base URL and adding headers
quote: By changing the base URL and adding Portkey-specific headers, you can quickly integrate Portkey’s features into your existing setup.

text: Offers a REST API with a documented base URL for all requests
quote: The base URL for all REST API requests is `https://api.portkey.ai/v1`

text: Can connect to remote MCP servers to use external tools and data sources
quote: Connect to Remote MCP severs, allowing you to connect external tools and data sources.

text: Supports per-strategy circuit breaker configuration and failure handling
quote: Configure per-strategy circuit protection and failure handling

text: Quick integration makes apps resilient, secure, performant, and more accurate
quote: It takes 2 mins to integrate and with that, it starts monitoring all of your LLM requests and makes your app resilient, secure, performant, and more accurate at the same time.

text: Unified interface for interacting with over 250 AI models with control, visibility, and security tools
quote: It serves as a unified interface for interacting with over 250 AI models, offering advanced tools for control, visibility, and security in your Generative AI apps.

text: Fallback triggers by default on any non-2xx status code, customizable via on_status_codes
quote: By default, fallback triggers on any **non-2xx** status code. Customize with `on_status_codes`

text: Supports gradual migration by testing new models on a small percentage of traffic before full rollout
quote: **Gradual Migration** | Test new models with small percentage before full rollout

text: Semantic caching matches requests with similar meaning via cosine similarity, not just exact text
quote: Matches requests with **similar meaning** using cosine similarity, not just identical text.

text: Can address models by provider-slug/model-name after adding a provider
quote: Add a provider, then use `@provider-slug/model-name` in your code.

text: Budget limits automatically stop further usage once spending or token thresholds are reached
quote: Budget limits allow you to set maximum LLM spending or token usage thresholds on your API keys, automatically preventing further usage when limits are reached.

text: Can canary test new models in production
quote: Canary test new models in production

text: Can route requests to privately hosted or local models via custom host URLs
quote: Route requests to privately hosted or local models using custom host URLs

text: Provider credentials are stored securely and never exposed in code
quote: Provider credentials stored securely, never exposed in code

text: Fine-grained budgets, rate limits, and model allow-lists at org and workspace level
quote: Fine-grained control: budgets, rate limits, and model allow-lists at both org and workspace level.

text: Manual feedback can be added to logs for later analysis and filtering
quote: you can also add manual feedback on the logs to be analysed and filtered later

text: Budget limits can be set to reset weekly on a schedule
quote: **Reset Weekly**: Budget limits reset every Sunday at 12 AM UTC

text: Open-sourced AI gateway can be run locally with a single command
quote: We've open sourced our battle-tested AI gateway to the community. You can run it locally with a single command:

text: Can set hourly, daily, or per-minute rate limits on requests or tokens
quote: Set hourly, daily, or per minute rate limits on requests or tokens sent
